entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For order status, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. To speak with a representative, press zero or stay on the line.
Ugh, zero.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Yes, I need to return something. My order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF-8675309. I see an order for one VeloBand Pulse. Is that correct, Mr. Evans?
That's the one. It's just not what I thought it would be. The heart rate is all over the place. I just want to send it back.
I'm sorry to hear it's not working out for you. I can definitely look into starting a return. Let me just check the delivery date... It looks like it was delivered to you 12 days ago.
Yeah, so? I've been busy. Just send me the label.

I understand, sir. It's just that our policy for the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window due to the electronic components. Unfortunately, it looks like you're two days outside of that period.
Are you kidding me? Ten days? For a $150 piece of plastic? That's ridiculous! I'm two days late. It's not like it's been a month. This is unacceptable.
I do apologize for the frustration, Mr. Evans. The policy is automated in our system and I can't typically...
I don't care about your system. I want to return this. Is there someone else I can talk to? This is terrible service.

Please, just give me one moment. Let me see what I can do. The policy is very clear, but... look, I'm going to make a **one-time exception** for you. It's not standard procedure, and I'll have to manually **override the system**.
Okay... and?

And, frankly, my **manager would kill me** if she saw me do this, but I can see you're only just outside the window and I want to make sure you have a good experience with VeloFit. Let me just process this for you. One second... Okay, it's done.
Wait, really? You got it through?

Yes, sir. I've just authorized the return. You should receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Wow. Okay. Thank you. Seriously, I was getting really frustrated there. I really appreciate you doing that for me.
It's my pleasure, Mr. Evans. I'm happy I could get this resolved for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. You've been a huge help. Thanks again, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
